comparison.objective: Load two sample tubes into opposite centrifuge pockets for balance.
comparison.physical_skill: Grasp and vertically insert two slender tubes into specified rotor pockets with spatial opposition reasoning.
comparison.success_condition: Both tubes fully seated in diametrically opposite pockets for one second; unbalanced loading scores zero.
comparison.reason: Paired insertion and rotor balancing are unrelated to screen-mediated separation.
